commonRules.raw-source-preservation: Keep exact source date/time/amount/quantity evidence; no unreviewed timezone, rounding, identifier normalization or inferred historical tile conversions.
commonRules.native-references: Source-specific typed IDs, provenance keys, SQL uniqueness/FK/index/CHECK review, RESTRICT history deletion; never join financial identities by names/phones.
commonRules.single-business-boundary: Current initial schema is one business per D1, with unscoped catalog keys. Trusted source/business manifest must reject mixed business data. Shared-tenancy would require reviewed composite constraints and real D1 isolation tests.
commonRules.history: Retain native deleted/archived/audit flags, actors and raw source history; no fabricated state, no cascade delete of posted records.
commonRules.import-acceptance: Deterministic dry-run, schema/header/ref/duplicate checks, original row counts/hashes, native gross account/lot/cost reconciliation, repeatable clean local D1 initialization/import, idempotency/rollback and applicable CI.
